company_context.executive_quote: Only reproduce a verbatim quotation when present in a verified primary source; include speaker full name, position and source URL. Otherwise use a factual third paragraph without a quotation. Never invent quotations, credentials, project dates or status.

images.image_url: Use a verified HTTPS asset or site-relative local asset; never assume a source image exists.
images.alt_text: Provide factual UA and EN alt text identifying a photograph, logo or conceptual illustration correctly.
images.rights: Record asset origin, copyright owner, license or written permission and any attribution requirements. A publicly visible press photograph or logo is not automatically licensed. Do not hotlink unverified assets, redraw prohibited trademarks or imply endorsement.
images.topic_fallback: If the source photograph is unavailable or its reuse is not authorized, and the company logo cannot lawfully be used, create or select an original, topic-specific image or engineering diagram depicting the actual technology discussed (e.g. EAF and ASU, agrivoltaics and heat pumps, solar-powered logistics, data-centre power, chemical-process electrification, pharmaceutical energy systems, waste-to-energy, wind, solar plus BESS). Follow the practical, subject-led illustration approach used in Chief Engineer Advice. Each news item must have its own relevant visual; do not reuse a generic IIG banner, invented company logo, stock photo of an unrelated facility, or misleading documentary image.
images.label: Clearly label original artwork UA/EN as conceptual illustration, not a photograph of the reported project. Do not claim it shows a real site or completed equipment.
images.rendering: Use compact responsive 16:9 cards and a restrained article hero; preserve aspect ratio, use object-fit:contain for logos and cover for suitable photographs or illustrations. Render consistently on homepage, all-news, industry cards and article; include descriptive alt, attribution when required and an onerror fallback to the item's own topic-specific original visual.
images.release_gate: Validate each of nine approved articles has a distinct relevant image, recorded origin and usage basis, UA/EN alt, correct caption, working asset URL and visual checks on home, news, industry and article before GREEN. Never publish an uncleared logo or source image simply to fill a card.

editorial.navigation: Every published card on home and industry pages must link to a full article derived from the same approved record. No hardcoded demo news in public listings. All nine configured industries must be audited for coverage, valid routing and honest empty states.
